text:
maya: Quick note — sampleapp ran into an embeddings+rerank mismatch when token refresh triggered a retry. missing vector + vec-dim flip. repro below.

eli: Can you paste the repro and logs?

maya: Repro: 8 docs, batch_size=3. force auth rotation during second sub-batch. Node SDK helper sometimes returns 7 vectors (one missing) and vec_dim switches from 768->512 after retry. Also sometimes the embeddings call returns a bare list instead of {"embeddings": [...]}.

frank: That sounds like two things: (1) mutable batch queue + retry -> missing/dup, (2) routing fallback to different model variant -> dim flip, (3) inconsistent SDK response shape.

maya: Logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-24T10:03:01Z] batching: enqueue ids=0..2 batch=0
[2026-03-24T10:03:01Z] batching: enqueue ids=3..5 batch=1
[2026-03-24T10:03:02Z] auth: token refresh start
[2026-03-24T10:03:02Z] embeddings: send batch=1 snapshot_ids=[3,4,5]
[2026-03-24T10:03:03Z] embeddings: 401 -> retry (snapshot used)
[2026-03-24T10:03:03Z] embeddings: response len=2 dim=512
[2026-03-24T10:03:03Z] final: merged=7 expected=8
```

eli: Key observations: server returned fewer vectors than inputs (should be an error), and dim changed. Short fixes: snapshot sub-batches before send (client), normalize SDK response shape (wrap list -> {"embeddings": list}), and fail-fast when response length != snapshot length. Longer term: add model alias contract enforcing output_dim across variants or route retries to the same variant.

frank: Agreed. Can we get a small patch in node helper to deep-copy sub-batch and normalize responses? Also add a unit test that simulates a 401 mid-send and asserts merged length==input count.

maya: Yup — opened PR with a snapshot+normalize shim and a mocha test: https://github.com/redwoodinc/sampleapp/pull/2501. Local runs pass.

eli: I'll add a tiny python shim that wraps list responses and logs a warning. Also adding a checklist item to SDK parity docs: "embeddings: always return object with embeddings key; preserve input order; merge by id; snapshot before send."

frank: I'll file an RFC to add model_alias output_dim contract and a server validation that rejects mixed-dim batches. If server ever returns N != inputs, it should return 400/409 with per-input error, not silently drop.

maya: sdk-ci-bot queued canary for branch maya/emb-snapshot (build 4650).

eli: tl;dr: cause = retry + mutable queue + routing variant; mitigations = snapshot before send, normalize SDK shapes, fail-fast on length mismatch, model alias dim contract + tests/docs.
